observations: Actual receive handler copies literal full address twice; address never becomes feedback; superseded completion has no success/haptic.
New copy clears prior reset timer; rejection replaces success with failure and preserves address.
Explicit receive status reset suppresses late success and restores original empty status.
Missing clipboard API reports failure without unhandled rejection or haptic.
Empty source is never written to clipboard and cannot report success.
A late completion cannot overwrite externally rerendered status text.
boundary: Production functions and receive event handler extracted verbatim; clipboard promises, DOM and timers are synthetic; no network, wallet or customer access.
